issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

dekValidity.description:
Data encryption key validity period in days. if not configured, data encryption key is not refreshed till the node
is restarted.

dekPoolSize.description:
Data Encryption Key pool size in terms of %. If not specified, it assumes 0.001% of number records that will be
ingested by the platform

keyForHash.description: Long term key used for hashing the data.

deletedKek.description: Key encryption key(Kek) which is deleted.
